from datetime import datetime, timezone
from src.scheduling.parsing import parse_event
from src.scheduling.core import reminder_hour_utc

def test_reminder_hour_utc():
    # Test case with offset
    raw_event = {
        "title": "Test Event",
        "start": "2026-03-10T09:00:00-05:00"
    }
    event = parse_event(raw_event)
    assert reminder_hour_utc(event) == 14

    # Test case without offset (naive, should be treated as UTC)
    raw_event_naive = {
        "title": "Test Event Naive",
        "start": "2026-03-10T09:00:00"
    }
    event_naive = parse_event(raw_event_naive)
    assert reminder_hour_utc(event_naive) == 9

    # Test case with UTC offset
    raw_event_utc = {
        "title": "Test Event UTC",
        "start": "2026-03-10T09:00:00+00:00"
    }
    event_utc = parse_event(raw_event_utc)
    assert reminder_hour_utc(event_utc) == 9

    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_reminder_hour_utc()
